description: This file defines several immutable data models related to social features in the application, including user profiles, friends, chat messages, and invite payloads. It provides methods for JSON serialization/deserialization and copy-with semantics.

classes.name: UserProfile
classes.description: Represents a user's profile with fields for user ID, display name, bio, and avatar URL.

classes.name: Friend
classes.description: Models a friend relationship, including user ID, display name, online status, and avatar URL.

classes.name: ChatMessage
classes.description: Encapsulates a chat message with details such as sender info, creation time, message kind (text or emote), and content.

classes.name: InvitePayload
classes.description: Represents an invitation payload with session ID and optional inviter info; includes a method for parsing from a URI.

classes.name: ChatMessageKind
classes.description: Enum distinguishing between text and emote chat message types.

methods.name: copyWith
methods.description: Creates a copy of the object with optional overridden fields.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes the object from a JSON map.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the object to a JSON map.

methods.name: text
methods.description: Factory method to create a text chat message.

methods.name: emote
methods.description: Factory method to create an emote chat message.

methods.name: fromUri
methods.description: Parses an InvitePayload from a URI, supporting deep link schemes.
